method: Static ARM64 BL imm26 analysis of previously captured 20,832-byte instruction slice; no Apple decoder run
ABIObservation: At callsites x0=input pointer, x1=input length, x2=output pointer, x3=expected output count; subsequent CMP x0,x3 tests return value against expected count. Verified in disassembly of five callsites, but not all paths.
limitations: No BYET per-kind numeric reconstruction or native golden parity. Python audit helper saved but remote execution was blocked by safety checks; this independent static inspection was performed without running the helper.
